info.title: erdigo-send: write pins, markers, notes, photos and tracks to a paired Erdigo receiver on the local network.
info.description: Writes pins, markers, notes, photos and tracks to a paired Erdigo receiver, and runs a mock receiver for testing.

options.name: --profile
options.description: Use a separate identity and pairings (default: "default").

options.name: --state-dir
options.description: Keep state in DIR instead of the default folder.

options.name: --redact
options.description:
Hide labels, keys and other identifying output, for pasting into a bug report.
With pair, it needs the QR text or --fingerprint, because a hidden key cannot be compared.
On Windows the device key is encrypted with DPAPI for the current Windows user, in %LOCALAPPDATA%\ErdigoSDK.
Elsewhere it is kept in a file of mode 0600.
